settings.heading: Choose your size.
settings.body: Every size is the same build. Thirty five centimetres, seven-zone core, removable comfort layer. You do not choose a firmness.
settings.firmness_line: It arrives medium firm with a flippable comfort layer.

settings.kicker: Why you cannot choose in a showroom
settings.heading:
Four minutes lying down
tells you nothing.
settings.body_1: You cannot know how a mattress feels until you have slept on it for weeks. By then the decision is behind you and the money is spent, which is why most people keep a mattress they never liked.
settings.body_2: So you do not choose a firmness when you order. Your mattress arrives, you sleep on it, and for a year you tell us how it should feel. We build a new comfort layer to that description and send it, with our compliments.
settings.pull: You do not choose the feel. You discover it.

settings.heading:
Thirty five centimetres,
assembled by hand.
settings.body_1: It begins as wire. Drawn, wound into coils, and each one dropped into its own fabric pocket so it can rise and fall without disturbing the one beside it. Two thousand of them in a super king, arranged in seven bands along the length of the bed.
settings.body_2: Heavier gauge under the hips and shoulders, where a body presses hardest. Lighter at the waist and the calves, where it does not. Nobody sinks evenly, so nothing is sprung evenly.
settings.body_3: Then the comfort is laid over it by hand, layer by layer, and the whole thing is closed under a zip that runs the full perimeter. Not glued. Glue is permanent, and nothing about this bed is meant to be.

settings.heading: It arrives finished.
settings.card_1_body: To the room you choose, unboxed, unrolled onto your bed and positioned. The packaging leaves with it.
settings.card_2_body: Taken away and sent for recycling. We carry the cost.
settings.card_3_body: We call before we come, and arrange a time that suits you. Nothing arrives unannounced.
settings.lede: Not left in a hallway in a box for you to wrestle upstairs.

settings.a1_body: A year to tell us how it should feel. We remake the comfort layer to that, with our compliments, as often as it takes.
settings.a2_body: Collected from your home and refunded in full. Emperor is made to order and excluded.
settings.a3_body: The part that carries you is guaranteed for a quarter of a century.
